description: This file implements a Coqui XTTS text-to-speech service, integrating with a local Dockerized XTTS streaming server. It defines the XTTSService class, including methods for initializing the service, starting it, and generating speech from text via streaming, with support for multiple languages and voice cloning.

classes.name: XTTSService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with the Coqui XTTS streaming server for text-to-speech synthesis, supporting multiple languages and voice cloning.

methods.name: language_to_xtts_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to an XTTS language code string.

methods.name: XTTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the XTTSService with voice ID, server URL, HTTP session, language, and optional sample rate.

methods.name: XTTSService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: XTTSService.language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to the XTTS-specific language code.

methods.name: XTTSService.start
methods.description: Starts the service and loads available studio speakers from the server.

methods.name: XTTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Streams synthesized speech frames from input text using the XTTS server.
